Generally a 30-minute minimum per engagement; incentives vary and are not guaranteed.

steps: Apply on the official Working Solutions jobs site and complete onboarding as an independent contractor.
Get assigned to a client program (rate $0.25–$0.31 per productive customer-interaction minute depending on program).
Take customer contacts on the program's schedule (generally with a 30-minute minimum).
Only productive interaction minutes are paid; idle time and breaks are unpaid.
Get paid per program payroll terms, plus any program incentives.
Complete and file your own self-employment taxes as a 1099 contractor.
timing: Ongoing applications; per-program scheduling; idle time unpaid.
